name: The Typewriter That Writes Tomorrow
description: An antique typewriter sits on a wooden desk, but instead of paper, it types words that materialize as glowing golden light and float upward to form tomorrow's headlines in the air.
prompt: A vintage antique typewriter on a weathered wooden desk, golden glowing letters appearing on the page and floating upward as shimmering light particles, forming tomorrow's newspaper headlines in elegant script floating in the air above, warm lamplight illuminating the scene, mysterious and prophetic atmosphere, highly detailed, steampunk fantasy art style, cinematic lighting
caption: Writing the future one keystroke at a time... ⌨️✨ What story will your tomorrow tell?
